Fig. 3: Method overview. With all CLIP parameters frozen, we extract hidden states at three layers identified by the LCD analysis (Sec. 3.2): anchor la, compositional peak lp, and final layer L. The ECN (Sec. 3.3) attends over the full token sequence at lp with a learned query, fuses the result with peak- and anchor-layer embeddings, and predicts a deviation vector δ added to the collapsed layer-L embedding. The SCN (Sec. 3.3) contrasts the corrected embedding f̂T with the lp representation and the image embedding fI to predict a bounded scalar correction ∆s to the cosine similarity. Both modules are trained jointly (Sec. 3.4) while all CLIP parameters remain frozen.
